Nordic open sandwiches on dark rye: smoked salmon with dill cream and egg, and leg ham with mustard butter and crunchy pickled cucumber. Boil 3 eggs for 9 minutes, cool and slice. Mix 100g cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest. Mash 40g soft butter with 2 tsp wholegrain mustard. Slice 1 Lebanese cucumber thin and toss with 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and salt for 10 minutes. Spread 4 slices of dark rye with dill cream and top with 150g smoked salmon and egg. Spread 4 more with mustard butter and top with 150g leg ham and the drained cucumber. Halve and serve.
M: Beef and pork meatballs with allspice in cream gravy, served with potatoes
Beef and pork meatballs with breadcrumbs, grated onion and allspice, browned in butter, simmered in a cream gravy, with mash and lingonberry jam.
Ice harvesters' creamy Nordic fish soup
the men cutting ice on the frozen lake

Chunks of salmon and white fish poached in a creamy fish broth with leek, carrot and potato, finished with dill and served with buttered rye. Soften 1 sliced leek, 2 diced carrots and 1 diced celery stick in 30g butter for 5 minutes. Add 500g diced potato and 1.2 litres fish stock and simmer 12 minutes. Stir in 250ml cream and bring back to a gentle simmer. Add 400g diced white fish such as ling and 300g diced salmon and poach for 4 minutes without stirring hard. Season, add a handful of chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon, and serve with buttered rye.
W: Soft cardamom yeast buns filled with thick custard

Soft cardamom buns, the centres filled with vanilla custard, tops spread with icing and dipped in desiccated coconut. Mix 450g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp cardamom, 60g sugar, 250ml warm milk, 1 egg and 60g butter and prove an hour. Shape 12 buns, press a hollow and fill with thick custard. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Spread icing on top and dip in coconut.
K: Hot milk steeped with cardamom and cinnamon, finished with chocolate

Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with cardamom, cinnamon and a pinch of salt, topped with whipped cream, marshmallows and grated chocolate. Warm 1 litre full cream milk with 4 lightly crushed cardamom pods and 1 cinnamon stick until steaming, then turn off and steep 10 minutes. Strain, return to the heat and whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp brown sugar and a pinch of salt until smooth and frothy. Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream, a few marshmallows and grated chocolate.
